issues.description: Unused variable 'dep_name' in _build_env() loop: 'for dep_name, dep in self.dependencies.items()'. The variable dep_name is never referenced in the loop body.
issues.fix_suggestion: Use 'for _, dep in self.dependencies.items()' to follow Python convention for unused loop variables.

issues.description: Build uses 'make -j1' which limits parallelism to a single job. This may unnecessarily slow CI builds if the retawq build system supports parallel compilation.
issues.fix_suggestion: If the itchconfig build system supports parallel builds, consider using 'make -j' (unlimited) or 'make -j8' to speed up CI. If -j1 is required due to build system limitations, add a comment explaining why.

issues.description: test_package only runs 'retawq --version' as a smoke test. While this verifies the binary starts and is linked correctly, it does not test actual web browsing functionality (HTTP fetch, ncurses rendering, TLS handshake).
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider adding a more functional test if feasible in CI, e.g., starting a local HTTP server and running 'retawq http://localhost:port/' to verify HTTP fetching and HTML rendering. Note: terminal-based testing may require a virtual terminal (e.g., screen/dtach).

issues.description: Compiler fallback uses str(self.settings.compiler) which yields a compiler name (e.g., 'clang') rather than a full executable path. In edge cases where the compiler is not in PATH, this may fail silently.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider using shutil.which() to verify the compiler is available, or use the full path from the Conan profile conf as the primary source (which the code already does correctly via self.conf.get()).
